NE.n: NE-facing is the most auspicious orientation — ideal for the entrance and living zone; the Ishan corner draws positive energy.

N.n: North-facing is highly auspicious — the Kuber (wealth) direction. Excellent for the living room and main entrance.

E.n: East-facing brings the sunrise energy — very good for the living room and dining where morning light is welcome.

SE.n: South-east is the Agni (fire) corner — ideal for the kitchen. The living zone here benefits from corrections to channel fire energy positively.

SW.n: South-west is the Nairutya (earth/stability) zone — the master bedroom corner. Living areas here need heavy south-west anchoring.

W.n: West-facing is neutral. Bedrooms in the west are acceptable; the living area can be balanced with lighter north-east furnishing.

S.n: South-facing needs careful planning — remedies include a heavy south wall and keeping the north-east light and open.

NW.n: North-west is the Vayu (air) zone — fine for guest rooms; the living area benefits from stable south-west furniture anchoring.
